newsitem.title: INDIA: CRICKET-ANWAR SMASHES 194 FOR ONE-DAY RECORD.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-ANWAR SMASHES 194 FOR ONE-DAY RECORD.

text.p: Pakistan opener Saeed Anwar smashed the highest individual score in one-day internationals on Wednesday -- 194 against India in the four-nation Independence Cup.
Left-hander Anwar beat the previous record of 189 by former West Indies captain Viv Richards against England at Old Trafford in 1984.
Anwar scored his runs off 147 balls before he was caught by Saurav Ganguly off Indian captain Sachin Tendulkar when going for a big hit.
Pakistan, playing their last preliminary match of the tournament, made 327 for five in their 50 overs.
